hypothesis: Forecasting next-day realized variance from completed day/week/month intraday variance improves conditional risk scaling of the existing frozen raw trend targets relative to past30 covariance and simple last-RV scaling.
mechanism: Five separate intercept OLS log-variance HAR(1,7,30 calendar days), once calibrated in2021H1. Features log(last completed RV), log(mean past7RV), log(mean past30RV). Train-only mean exp(residual) smearing maps positive forecasts to variance. No direction prediction, relative asset re-ranking or refit.

original_basis.distinction: Original author study uses bias-adjusted FX tick volatility/workdays. Fixed crypto 5min log-variance with7/30calendar days is an adaptation, not original2009 empirical replication. Published fulltext inaccessible; no bypass.

fit.label: next-day RV, mature at decision+1day
fit.thresholds: training-only per-asset95percentile max5min close/open-day logrise for ex-post tail classification; no threshold tuning

diagnosis.purge: July1 decision omitted; all fit labels mature before July2; labels daily nonoverlapping. Future outcomes used ONLY for diagnosis.
diagnosis.primary_loss: QLIKE y/p-log(y/p)-1. Paired joint-date7day block bootstrap1000seed811130, no IID asset pooling.
diagnosis.pass_gate: HAR pooled meanQLIKE improved>=2percent over BOTH lastRV and past30meanRV in BOTH halves, at least3of5assets improve versus each baseline in each half, and pooled paired bootstrap95upper<0 against both. Complete common dates/finite masks and causal future perturbation must pass. No MSE-only adoption.

frozen_strategy.arm: raw ONLY: frozen weeklyCSMOM21 with common past-beta BTC hedge/risk rules; never rerun residual or failed ETH/BTC recipe
frozen_strategy.all_changes: one nonnegative common daily scalar, preserve directions, relative legs and .3/.6caps

risk_scaling: Reuse saved base weights. Predicted covariance = sqrt(forecastRV) diagonal * correlation(past30daily simple returns) * same diagonal; annualize365. HAR scalar=min(1,.10/forecast_portfolio_sigma). lastRV scalar uses identical correlation/algorithm but last completedRV; no gross/asset cap or10percent parameter increase. STATIC scalar is train-only average HAR scalar, frozen before diagnostics. This controls constant haircut, not exact realized-risk equality.
risk_diagnosis: Report actual projected gross, weight turnover and next-day fixed-weight realised variance; ex-post short-tail (maxup>training95), rebound (past21negative and next-daydailypositive), normal downward trend (past21negative,next-daynonpositive,not tail), plus all days/long legs. These masks never select windows/assets or create signals.

economics_if_predictive_pass.reason: Complete originalJan-Nov mark coverage; full first available H2segment, not selected by outcomes. December fullmark absent.
economics_if_predictive_pass.engine: shared perpetual_directional with corrected BybitIsolatedAccount v2 permanent unpaidHALT, modern markMM rule on old Binance tape/uncertified MMR. Exact new SHA bound; all fees/slippage/funding,realrisk reductions,availability,charged terminal.
economics_if_predictive_pass.economic_adoption: No adoption from prediction loss alone. Need HAR net>=BASE30 and STATIC and LAST_RV in both units; tailshort net/loss-risk improvement and no material rebound/normal-trend damage. Report actual exposure/vol/DD/cost/funding; any benefit solely explainable by reduced exposure is risk mitigation, not alpha. Static haircut does not establish exact risk matching; no ex-post upsizing or oracle.

stop: Fixed HAR mechanism failure preserves result; no threshold/refit/pair/window rescue. Then inspect one independent data-value module or exact information gap, rather than declaring all research over.
